title: Autofix agent (mini SWE-agent)

links.label: Agent PRs on the demo repo

tagline: Turns a GitHub issue into a reviewed pull request: a failing test first, then the fix, proven in a Docker sandbox. It never merges.
problem: A model that edits code is only worth trusting when something other than the model proves the fix.
built: A hand-written agent loop on the Claude Messages API (Claude Opus 5.5) with JSON-schema tools, prompt caching and hard caps on steps, cost and time. The harness, not the model, enforces the order inside a non-root, network-cut Docker container: a failing test first, then the fix, and submit only once the suite, a no-weakened-tests check and the linter pass. The patch lands on a fix/issue-N branch as a PR with root cause, test output and token cost.
highlights: Six planted bugs: 6/6 fixed in 4 to 5 turns each, $0.28 in total
Sandbox with CPU, memory and process limits, no network after install, no secrets, command denylist
Every run logged as a JSONL trajectory with a viewer
The first live run exposed a real harness bug; the model reported it instead of gaming it, now a regression test
testing: A mock provider replays recorded trajectories, so the whole pipeline runs in CI without an API key, including the real Docker sandbox tests.
